correctness.rationale: For every fixed integer \(\ell\ge2\), \(s\ge3\), exact conditioning gives equation (1). The scaled forbidden union has leading contribution from voter subsets of size \(\ell\), with cross-subset intersections requiring at least \(\ell+1\) coordinates and vanishing at first order. The score integral has a verified uniform integrable majorant using \(\sigma_\ell\) and \(m>\ell\); dominated convergence gives the finite positive coefficient, while L1 density convergence gives conditional total variation. The positivity configuration is a cyclic three-block profile with reversed extra voter pairs. The standalone exact finite checks validate event equivalence and overlap algebra but do not claim an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The recent fixed-size Smith-set theorem explicitly leaves an unknown leading coefficient and rare-set internal score geometry. The result determines both for every fixed odd electorate and every fixed size at least three, using a nontrivial overlap-sensitive union-of-boxes integral and proving tightness of the conditional microscopic point cloud. This sharpens a motivated probabilistic-combinatorial question, not a numerical table adjustment or a relabeled textbook deduction.
